title: Savory Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and hearty Middle Eastern-inspired dish made with chicken and pilaf.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add pilaf to skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, spices, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through and pilaf is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
